limitations: Automation cannot certify audible quality; owner listening review remains required.
The certified browser reported no local Nepali voice, so native Nepali playback remains unavailable.
Mixed-language pronunciation quality is not certified.
Browser SpeechRecognition returned not-allowed in the interactive runtime after the permission probe; the text fallback passed.
Browser SpeechRecognition processing locality is browser-controlled and is not claimed local by SaathiOS.
Full acoustic barge-in is not implemented; behavior is stop and push-to-interrupt only.
Voice preferences are browser-profile scoped, not server per-user records.
non_actions: No external voice provider, paid API, credential, or cloud speech service was enabled.
No authentication, RBAC, workspace-isolation, private-alpha, trading, or provider-connectivity boundary was weakened.
No owner password, cookie, browser storage value, token, audio, or transcript was inspected or recorded.
No push, merge, deployment, release, or pull-request modification was performed.
